false_negatives.profile: 77/83 male. 41 in 3rd class, 32 in 1st class. 1st class males: mean age 43, mean fare 46.5. These are higher-status males who survived but model predicts dead.

false_positives.profile: 55/67 female. 46 in 3rd class, all female. Mean FamilySize 1.70. 3rd class females with large families (5+) have 0% survival but model predicts survived.

model_comparison.disagreement_insight: LR and RF disagree on 97 cases. LR right on 55 that RF misses, RF right on 42 that LR misses. Voting ensemble could capture both.

ablation_findings: FamilySize: +0.0148 contribution. Most impactful new feature.
IsAlone: -0.0051 contribution. Removing it IMPROVES F1. Redundant with FamilySize, adds noise.
Title_* features: all near-zero or slightly negative. Sex already captures most of the signal. Title adds noise to LR.

improvement_directions.rationale: Ablation shows -0.0051 contribution. Redundant with FamilySize. Removing it improved F1 to 0.7803.
improvement_directions.evidence: ablation: without IsAlone F1=0.7803 vs with F1=0.7752

improvement_directions.direction: Remove individual Title dummies, keep Sex only
improvement_directions.rationale: All Title features have near-zero or negative ablation contribution in LR. Sex(+1.21 coef) already captures the main signal. Title adds multicollinearity.

improvement_directions.direction: Add Pclass x Sex interaction feature
improvement_directions.rationale: 3rd class females have 34.7% misclass rate vs 1st class females 3.2%. Current model treats Sex uniformly across classes. Interaction captures class-dependent survival pattern.
improvement_directions.evidence: FP concentrated in 3rd class females (46/67). 3rd class female survival 50% vs 1st class female 97%.

improvement_directions.rationale: 3rd class females with FamilySize 5+ have 0% survival. Current FamilySize is linear but pattern is non-linear (2-4 optimal, 5+ catastrophic).
improvement_directions.evidence: 3rd class female FamilySize 5+: 0% survival (19 cases). FamilySize 1-4: 56-83% survival.

improvement_directions.rationale: 95 cases all 3 models get wrong (hard cases). But LR captures 21 cases RF/GB miss, and RF captures 17 LR/GB miss. Soft voting could improve borderline cases.
improvement_directions.evidence: Model disagreement: 97 cases where LR and RF differ.

improvement_directions.rationale: Default threshold 0.5 may not be F1-optimal. With class imbalance 62:38, optimal threshold is likely lower.

recommendation: Continue to iteration 2. High-impact direction: Pclass x Sex interaction + remove IsAlone/Title noise + FamilySize buckets.
